'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Bombing of Kryvyi Rih (2022–present)|Bombing of Kryvyi Rih]]
****At least six [[civilian]]s are killed and 75 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[ballistic missile]] strike on an apartment complex and a university building in [[Kryvyi Rih]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/07/31/russia-ukraine-war-missile-attack-kryvyi-rih/1adfc986-2f7d-11ee-85dd-5c3c97d6acda_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[Bombing of Kherson (2022–present)|Bombing of Kherson]]
****Russian forces strike residential areas in [[Kherson]], killing at least four civilians and injuring 17 others. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-31-23/h_88d2b755dc211b3347ece2dd94f084f7 (CNN International)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2023 Khar bombing]]
***The [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State-KP]] claims responsibility for yesterday's [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] at a [[Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (F)]] rally in [[Khar, Bajaur|Khar]], [[Bajaur District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], which killed 54 people and injured around 200 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/31/pakistan-holds-funerals-as-government-vows-to-hound-those-responsible (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Twelve [[FARC dissidents]] and a [[National Army of Colombia|soldier]] are killed during a [[shootout]] in a mountainous region in [[Cauca Department]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/clashes-between-gangs-military-kill-least-20-colombia-2023-07-31/ (Reuters)]
**Seven [[Clan del Golfo]] members are killed and four arrested after soldiers stormed one of their camps in [[Chocó Department]]. [https://elcomercio.pe/mundo/latinoamerica/colombia-siete-muertos-y-cuatro-heridos-en-operaciones-contra-el-clan-del-golfo-choco-carlos-alberto-serrano-medio-baudo-rio-purricha-oscar-leonel-murillo-carlos-camargo-ultimas-noticia/ (El Comercio)]
*[[2023 Ain al-Hilweh clashes]]
**Clashes between rival groups in the [[Ain al-Hilweh]] [[Palestinian refugee camps|Palestinian refugee camp]] in [[Sidon District]], [[Lebanon]], continue for the second day, with six more people being killed, bringing the death toll to eleven. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-66354364 (BBC News)]
*[[Religious violence in India]]
**[[2023 Haryana riots]]
***Four people are killed and 20 more wounded during clashes between [[Hinduism in India|Hindus]] and [[Islam in India|Muslims]] in [[Nuh district]], [[Haryana]], [[India]], after [[Muslim]]s attack a [[Hindu]] [[procession]] passing through. [https://apnews.com/article/india-violence-clashes-haryana-muslims-hindus-a4e5d0bd9427c85bdb311d64fdf98f08 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[UNESCO]] recommends the inclusion of [[Venice]], [[Italy]], a [[World Heritage Site]], on its [[List of World Heritage in Danger]] due to [[overtourism]] and [[flood]]ing. [https://edition.cnn.com/travel/unesco-venice-heritage-danger-list/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**[[France–Niger relations]]
***[[Niger]]'s [[military junta]] accuses [[government of France|France]] of wanting to intervene by force to reinstate ousted president [[Mohamed Bazoum]], a day after [[ECOWAS]] gave an ultimatum for Bazoum's reinstatement. The [[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|French foreign ministry]] denies the accusation. [https://www.wionews.com/world/nigers-military-junta-claims-france-plotting-military-intervention-paris-denies-621197 (AFP via WION)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/niger-junta-says-government-authorised-french-strikes-2023-07-31/ (Reuters)]
**The [[politics of Burkina Faso|governments of Burkina Faso]] and [[politics of Mali|Mali]] issue a joint statement saying that any [[Interventionism (politics)|military intervention]] in Niger to overthrow the new [[National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland|military junta]] will be considered a "declaration of war" against both countries. [https://www.barrons.com/news/niger-military-intervention-would-be-declaration-of-war-on-burkina-faso-and-mali-joint-statement-d8285fae (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] imposes sanctions on the judges and officials involved in the [[prosecution]] of activist [[Vladimir Kara-Murza]], who lost the appeal of his 25-year [[sentence (law)|sentence]] for [[treason]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/uk-sanctions-russian-judges-officials-involved-kara-murza-trial-2023-07-31/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Senegalese protests]]
**The [[Ministry of Justice (Senegal)|Ministry of Justice]] [[criminal charge|charges]] detained [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] leader and [[Ziguinchor]] mayor [[Ousmane Sonko]] with fomenting [[insurrection]], undermining [[Senegal|state]] security, and criminal association with a [[terrorist]] body. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20230731-senegalese-opponent-sonko-says-he-has-started-hunger-strike-over-arrest (AFP via France 24)]
**Two people are killed in Ziguinchor during protests in response to Sonko's arrest and indictment. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/two-dead-in-senegal-protests-after-detention-of-opposition-figure-sonko (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]], [[Myanmar protests (2021–present)|Myanmar protests]]
**Acting [[President of Myanmar|President]] [[Myint Swe]] announces the [[National Defence and Security Council]]'s extension of [[Myanmar|the country]]'s [[state of emergency]] by six months,  likely delaying the [[Next Myanmar general election|general election]] that was previously pledged to be held by August, saying that the country's situation has "not returned to normalcy yet". [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/31/world/myanmar-junta-extends-state-of-emergency-delaying-polls/1903277 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[October 2021 Tokyo attack]]
**The [[Tokyo District Court]] sentences Kyota Hattori to 23 years in [[Penal system of Japan|prison]] for [[attempted murder]] and [[arson]] on a [[Rail transport in Japan|train]] in [[Chōfu]], [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]], in October 2021. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-stabbing-attack-ruling-train-joker-7b0bc0e6267561e6f80ab1295a65b324 (AP)]
*[[2023 Jaipur Express killings]]
**Four people are shot dead on a [[Jaipur Superfast Express]] train near [[Palghar district|Palghar]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]], by a [[Railway Protection Force]] constable on escorting duty. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/rpf-jawan-shoots-four-dead-inside-jaipur-mumbai-train/articleshow/102260189.cms?from=mdr (TNN via ''Times of India'')]
